batting.name: Rahmanullah Gurbaz
batting.dismissal: c Rashid Khan b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: SN Thakur
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b J Little

batting.name: RK Singh
batting.dismissal: c J Little b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: AD Russell
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c Harshit Rana b AD Russell

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c AD Russell b SP Narine

balls.text: taken at deep point! What an anti-climax! Full and hung outside off stump. Russell throws the kitchen sink at it but the ball is just too far away from his arc. Slices it eventually and hits it straight down deep point's throat!
edged and four! Slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Russell gives it everything he has and gets a massive top edge that evades short third man and bobbles away into the fence
watch that fly! In the slot on middle and leg stump. Russell opens up his stance and massacres it over wide long on! That travelled 94 metres!
sharp bumper on middle and leg stump. Russell does not pick it early enough and is awfully late on his swipe. Wonderful by Shami!
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Wiese leans back and chalks it towards long off
yorker on middle and leg stump. Russell squeezes it out towards deep mid wicket and has to settle for a single
Little travels the distance! In the slot on middle and leg stump, and that is just what Wiese is after! He has a clean swing through the line and sends it soaring over the wide long on fence!
banged into the track outside off stump. Russell clears his front leg and slaps it towards deep cover point. Just a single, though
slot ball on middle and leg stump. Russell has a massive mow at it and drags it to long on's right for a couple of runs
full delivery on middle and off stump. Russell gives himself a bit of room but can't slice it past the fielder at extra cover
dug into the track outside off stump. Wiese continues swiping and cloths it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
excellent yorker at the stumps. Russell gets his bat down in time and digs it out into the off side for a single
full delivery down the leg side. Wiese has a swipe at it but can only skew it towards short fine leg
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Wiese has a waft at it but is beaten for pace as the ball whizzes past the flailing blade
full and fired into the pads. Wiese plays all over it as the ball smashes into the pads. Might have pitched outside leg, though

Noor gets Rinku! Flighted nicely on a full length outside off stump. Rinku's eyes light up but this one is just far enough away from his hitting arc. He has a swing at it but slices it. Little settles himself at long off and does the rest! After the high of his previous game against GT, this is not a knock Rinku will look back on fondly!
length delivery on leg stump. Russell tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg. He is intent on the second but Rinku sends him back
yes, he will!  Dragged down outside off stump. Russell clears his front leg, winds up and blasts it back past the bowler for four!
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Russell turns it behind square on the leg side for one more run
Russell goes big again! In the slot on middle and leg stump. Russell gets down on one knee and slugs it flat over deep mid wicket!
googly on a length on middle and off stump. Russell stays leg side of the ball and jabs it towards backward point
back of a length delivery on off stump. Russell gets onto the back foot and defends into the off side
Russell takes on Rashid! Googly that lands right in the slot outside off stump. Russell plants his front foot and smokes it over long on!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rinku picks the googly off the pitch and knocks it down the ground for a single
googly on a full length on leg stump. Russell comes forward and flicks it towards the fielder at mid wicket
length delivery on off stump. Rinku goes back and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket
short and wide outside off stump. Russell gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep point for a single
googly on a length on leg stump. Russell plays all over it as the ball pings him on the pads

holes out to deep mid wicket! Very full delivery at the pads that seems to cramp Gurbaz up for room. He has a swing at it anyway but cannot generate the power he is after. Arrows it towards deep mid wicket, where Rashid comes in from the fence and completes a smart take diving forward! What a knock this has been, though! It has, almost single-handedly, kept KKR in the hunt for a score in the 180-190 region!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rinku guides it towards deep cover point for one more run
length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz nudges it into the vast real estate on the leg side and scampers back for the second
four more! Short delivery on middle and leg stump. Gurbaz rocks back and razes it past deep mid wicket for another boundary!

in the air and it clears long off comfortably! Given a bit of air on a length outside off stump. Gurbaz seems to be a little early into the stroke but manages to muscle it well over the long off fence!
full delivery just outside off stump. Rinku winds up but ends up dragging it towards deep square leg for a single
full delivery just outside off stump. Rinku plants his front foot and drags it towards long on for a brace
length delivery on leg stump. Gurbaz goes back and stabs it towards deep mid wicket for one
googly that goes awry and slides down the leg side. Called a wide by the umpire
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Gurbaz waits for the ball to arrive before dabbing it towards short third man
short and wide outside off stump. Rinku cuts it towards deep cover point for another single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rinku gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep cover point for a couple of runs
ouch! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rinku has a swing at it and misses. Cops a blow in the midriff that seems to have hurt him
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rinku gets onto the back foot and turns it behind square on the leg side for a brace
and Rinku welcomes him with a six! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Rinku gets inside the line of the ball and helps it over the fine leg fence
dug into the track on leg stump. Rinku takes a step down the track and tugs it towards deep square leg for just a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that bounces a tad extra. Rinku fends it towards backward point
back of a length delivery just outside leg stump. Rinku advances and hacks at it but makes no contact whatsoever
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rinku gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
full delivery just outside off stump. Gurbaz bunts it down the ground and dashes across to the other end
and he gets smashed over cow corner! In the slot outside off stump. Gurbaz plants his front foot and clubs it a mile over the deep mid wicket fence!
full toss outside off stump. Rinku reaches out for it and drills it straight to the fielder at extra cover
googly on a back of a length on leg stump. Gurbaz hangs back and pushes it into the off side for a single
low full toss outside off stump. Rinku chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards long on to get off the mark
length delivery just outside off stump. Rinku does not pick the leg-spinner and prods it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gurbaz goes back and works it behind square on the leg side for a single
Gurbaz continues on his merry way! Given a bit of air on a full length on leg stump. Gurbaz backs away early and bangs it over long off
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rinku waits in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
full delivery just outside off stump. Rinku comes half forward and pokes it towards mid off

straight to backward point! Back of a length delivery outside off stump that seems to stick in the surface just a tad. Nitish has a waft at it but does so without any conviction, spooning it straight to the fielder in the circle! KKR lose two in quick succession, and Gujarat are right back in this!
edged and four! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Nitish dangles his bat and gets a thick outside edge that races away past third man
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rana has a waft at it but is beaten for pace as the ball fizzes past the outside edge

huge appeal, and that looks very adjacent! Full and slanted into middle and off stump. Iyer, who is standing a foot outside leg stump even before the ball has been bowled, now decides to walk across and lap it. He misses it and is pinned on the back leg, right in front of middle and leg stump. The umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger but Iyer, for some reason, wants to have another look. This already seems a very poor review. Indeed it is. No bat involved and that is thundering into middle stump. KKR have burnt both of their reviews and they have been very ordinary, to say the least!
yorker on leg stump. Iyer lets the ball come to him before tucking it away towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length on middle and off stump. Iyer reads it off the surface and plonks it back to the bowler
length delivery outside off stump that spins away. Iyer has a waft at it but sees the ball spin past the outside edge
short and wide outside off stump. Gurbaz cuts it hard but can't beat the sweeper at deep cover point
full delivery just outside off stump. Iyer lunges forward and pushes it down the ground towards long on
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump that hurries onto Iyer. He has a swipe at it and gets an inside edge into his pads
full delivery fired down the leg side. Iyer does not get bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz gets up on his toes and runs it down to third man for a couple of runs. Gets to fifty too, off just 27 balls!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz fences at it away from his body and is beaten by the angle and the extra pace
yorker slanted into leg stump. Iyer gets his bat down in time and digs it out towards long on for another single
safe! Full delivery on off stump. Gurbaz shuffles across his stumps and flicks it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz advances and has a wild hack at it, only connecting with fresh air
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Iyer comes half forward and flicks it towards long on for one
length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz lunges forward and defends into the off side
full delivery on leg stump. Iyer pokes it towards long off and canters across to the other end
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Iyer comes onto the front foot and drives it back past the bowler. Gets back for a couple of runs
full and fired into middle and leg stump. Gurbaz gets forward and knocks it down the ground for a single
four more! Googly that lands right in the slot outside off stump. Gurbaz plants his front foot and lifts it over extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Iyer goes back and punches it towards deep cover point
back of a length delivery in the channel that nips away just a touch. Gurbaz has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz tries to repeat the stroke but this time, can't beat the fielder at backward point
deft! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz waits in his crease, uses the pace and glides it between backward point and short third man
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz gives it the lot but does not make any contact whatsoever
back of a length delivery pushed across the batter outside off stump. Gurbaz goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
length delivery on middle and off stump. Iyer takes a step down the track and stabs it towards long on for one
full delivery on middle and off stump. Iyer punches it towards mid off and immediately sets off for the single. Makes it comfortably because the fielder misfields
googly on a length on middle and leg stump. Gurbaz pushes it into the on side and ambles across to the other end
dragged down outside off stump this time. Gurbaz walks across his stumps and paddles it neatly over short fine leg for another boundary!
Gurbaz lays into Rashid! Given a bit of air on a length just outside off stump. Gurbaz swings through the line and pumps it over Rashid's head for six!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Iyer comes forward and tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket to get off the mark
googly on a back of a length on middle and leg stump. Gurbaz goes back and works it into the leg side for one

taken brilliantly by Mohit running back from mid on! Full and angled into the stumps. Shardul plants his front foot and looks to go over mid on. He does not time it very well, though, and the ball goes miles up into the air. Mohit judges it, runs back and then takes a sensational catch over his shoulder!
length delivery outside off stump that hurtles through. Shardul has a fish at it but is awfully late on the stroke. Gets beaten all ends up!
length delivery just outside off stump. Shardul comes onto the front foot and pokes it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gurbaz goes back and turns it into the leg side for a single
shot! Full and slanted into the stumps. Gurbaz does not care about it one bit, backs away and slams it over the bowler's head!
and he gets met! Fractionally short outside off stump. Gurbaz opens up his stance and hammers it in front of square, over mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gurbaz tucks it off his hips towards mid wicket for a single
sharp bumper outside off stump. Gurbaz has a swipe across the line but is late on the stroke as the ball whistles past the flailing blade
big shot! Full delivery angled into leg stump. Gurbaz, this time, gives himself room and mauls it over the deep square leg fence!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz gets onto the back foot and dabs it towards backward point
into the stands! Dug into the track outside off stump. Gurbaz picks up the length in a flash, walks across his stumps and helps it comfortably over the fine leg fence!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gurbaz gets up on his toes and defends it back to the bowler
length delivery just outside off stump. Shardul comes half forward and hurriedly prods at it. Keeps it out in the end

huge appeal, and given! Full delivery angled into off stump. Jagadeesan walks across his stumps and then plays all over it as the ball smashes into the pads. Shami goes up and so does the umpire's finger Jagadeesan wants to have another look at this but if the impact is in line, it could be curtains! No bat involved and that hit him just below the knee roll of the front pad. Impact is in line too, and Ball Tracking shows the ball smashing into the middle of middle stump. Jagadeesan has to go!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jagadeesan uses the pace and runs it down to third man for a couple of runs
four more! Short and just wide enough outside off stump. Jagadeesan gives himself even more room and carves it past backward point
back of a length delivery on off stump. Jagadeesan goes walkabouts down the track before stabbing it towards cover point
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gurbaz lets the ball come to him before helping it behind square on the leg side for a single

oh dear! Full delivery outside off stump. Jagadeesan has a hack across the line and gets a top edge that flies towards third man. Manohar misjudges it terribly and after racing in, sees the ball clear his head, bounce before the rope and hit the advertising hoardings!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jagadeesan gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards cover point
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jagadeesan waits in his crease, holds his shot long enough and cuts it powerfully past backward point for four!
length delivery outside off stump that shapes away. Jagadeesan backs away and swishes at it. Misses again!
back of a length delivery way outside off stump. Jagadeesan wafts and misses but then sees the umpire indulge in a bit of exercise
edged and four! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jagadeesan continues swinging like a rusty gate and this time, gets a thick outside edge that flies over slip
back of a length delivery outside off stump that zips away. Jagadeesan goes feeling for it and sees the ball seam past the outside edge
full delivery just outside off stump. Gurbaz squeezes it into the leg side and scampers back for the second, with the fielder at mid wicket helping him out with a misfield
length delivery just outside off stump. Jagadeesan comes half forward and plonks it towards mid off before haring across to the other end
swing and a miss again! Length delivery on off stump that curves away very late. Jagadeesan backs away and tries to hit it into next week but misses it by a considerable distance
back of a length delivery on off stump. Jagadeesan gets up on his toes and taps it towards mid on
back of a length delivery outside off stump that leaves the batter late. Jagadeesan has a massive swish at it but gets nowhere close to the ball
full delivery on middle and leg stump that shapes away just a tad. Jagadeesan comes half forward and prods it towards mid on

that will be that! A wide to finish it off! Full delivery fired down the leg side. Shankar swings and misses but then sees the umpire indulge in a bit of exercise! GT go to the top of the table and all the optimism generated after KKR's win against RCB at Bengaluru, has evaporated into smoke!
scores level! Shankar goes to fifty, off just 24 balls! Length delivery on leg stump. Shankar gets down on one knee again and mousses it over deep backward square leg!
full delivery outside off stump. Miller shimmies around his crease before driving it towards deep extra cover for one
full delivery on leg stump. Shankar opts to stay back before working it towards deep mid wicket
four more! Full delivery down the leg side. Shankar gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it powerfully past deep square leg!
length delivery at the stumps. Miller shanks it down the ground for a single
third six of the over! Dragged down outside off stump. Shankar has all the time in the world to rock back and smear it over cow corner!
back of a length delivery on off stump that spins back. Shankar is cut in half but the ball deflects off the thigh pad and races away past short third man for four!
short and wide outside off stump. Miller goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point for one
short and wide outside off stump. Shankar hacks it into the track and it somehow bounces over the bowler's head. Gets a single for his troubles
but it does not matter one bit! Slot ball on middle and leg stump. Shankar gets down on one knee early and pounds it over deep square leg!
but Shankar pummels him 10 rows back over deep mid wicket! In the slot outside off stump again. Shankar brings out the slog sweep and clatters it well over the fence!
slower delivery dug into the track on off stump. Shankar hoicks it away towards deep backward square leg
yorker just outside off stump. Shankar tries to slice it fine but does not get any bat on it whatsoever
six more! Shankar into the act now! Slower delivery that just sits up to be hit outside off stump. Shankar obliges, clears his front leg and bashes it over wide long on!
that might hurt! Full delivery outside off stump. Shankar sits back in his crease and smashes it back to the bowler. Russell can't get his hands down in time and cops a blow flush on the boot
slower delivery that goes awry and slides down the leg side. Shankar does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
full and outside off stump. Miller gets forward and drills it down the ground towards long off

dropped, oh dear! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump that holds in the surface. Miller swipes at it and gets a massive top edge. The ball goes miles up into the air and when it comes down, Suyash does not even get his hands to it
very full delivery outside off stump. Shankar comes forward and pokes it towards the fielder at cover point
shot! Fractionally short outside off stump. Shankar waits in his crease, gets his hands through the ball and crunches it past cover point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Miller chops it towards short third man for one
clean as a whistle! In the arc, and that goes out of the park! Miller swings through the line and pummels it well over the long on fence!
six more! In the slot just outside off stump. Miller plants his front foot and smacks it flat over the long off fence!
length delivery at the stumps that hurries onto the batter. Shankar goes back and stabs it down the ground
breaks the shackles! Short, wide and finally Miller capitalises! He rocks onto the back foot and crashes it past extra cover for four!
length delivery outside off stump that moves away. Shankar sits back in his crease and pushes it towards deep extra cover
short outside off stump. Miller scuffs it down the ground and trudges across to the other end
slowed up nicely on a length on middle and leg stump. Miller has a slog across the line and misses the ball by quite some distance. That missed the stumps by a whisker!
short and wide outside off stump. Miller waits in his crease and jabs it past extra cover for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on off stump. Shankar knocks it down the ground for a single
flighted on a full length outside off stump. Shankar reaches out for it and heaves it towards long on for one
length delivery just outside off stump. Shankar goes back and defends it towards backward point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Shankar hangs back in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
full delivery outside off stump. Shankar plants his front foot and drags it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
another googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Miller goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point
googly on a full length outside off stump. Miller throws his hands at it but sees the ball rip past the outside edge of the bat
length delivery just outside off stump. Miller drops it into the off side and canters across to the other end
oh! Length delivery outside off stump. Miller initially thinks about the sweep. He then changes his stroke and gets just enough bat to beat the keeper
length delivery outside off stump that grips in the surface just a little. Miller defends into the off side
length delivery angled into middle and off stump. Miller goes back and pats it into the off side

skies it and Narine bags Gill! Given just a hint of air on a full length outside off stump. Gill comes down the track and tries to tonk it into next week. Does not get to the pitch of the ball, though, and shanks it off the toe-end towards deep mid wicket. Russell does the rest and the noise at the Eden Gardens now is deafening!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Shankar comes forward and pushes it down the ground towards long on
short delivery outside off stump. Shankar looks for the pull but chunks it off the inside edge into his thigh pad. Gets a single off the deflection, though
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Shankar gets onto the back foot and pokes it towards extra cover

Harshit breaks through! Full and slanted into middle and off stump. Hardik shuffles across and then plays all over it. Gets pinned on the pads and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger! Hardik does not even bother with the review and that is the right call. That was plumb in front!
short delivery outside off stump. Gill gets on top of the bounce and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket. Moves to 49!
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Hardik prods it into the off side and hares across to the other end
length delivery outside off stump. Hardik has a massive swish at it but gets nowhere close to the ball in the end
full delivery just outside off stump. Hardik comes onto the front foot and pokes it past extra cover for a single
length delivery on off stump. Gill stays leg side of the ball and cuts it towards deep point for one more run
length delivery just outside off stump. Hardik comes forward and punches it towards long on
massive! In the slot and that goes many a mile! Hardik gets down on one knee very early and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
fractionally short on middle and leg stump. Gill rocks onto the back foot and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket
full and at the stumps. Hardik knocks it down the ground and collects another single
googly on a length outside off stump. Hardik presses forward and drives it on the up to long off
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Gill comes forward and eases it towards deep mid wicket
very full delivery on leg stump. Hardik squeezes it out towards long on for a single
shot! Flighted into the slot just outside off stump. Hardik gets close enough to the pitch of the ball and thumps it over the bowler's head for four!
googly on a length on middle and off stump. Gill reads it off the surface and nudges it into the leg side for a single
length delivery just outside off stump. Gill comes half forward and defends into the off side
length delivery just outside off stump that moves away. Gill accounts for it and punches it towards deep cover point
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Hardik comes forward and pushes it down the ground
full delivery on middle and off stump. Gill comes forward and turns it into the on side for another single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Hardik pushes it towards deep cover point for one more run
back of a length delivery on off stump. Hardik places it into the vast open spaces on the leg side and gets back for the second quite comfortably
length delivery angled into the stumps. Gill takes a step down the track and works it into the leg side for one
short and wide outside off stump. Gill goes back and jabs it towards deep point for one
oh dear! Short delivery on off stump. Gill rocks back and smashes it towards deep mid wicket, where Rinku produces an inexplicable misfield and lets in the boundary!
full and outside off stump. Gill comes forward and digs it out towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Hardik goes back and punches it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gill gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep point
googly on a back of a length down the leg side. Gill does not get bat on it but the ball kisses enough of the thigh pad to beat the keeper, short fine leg and run away for four
googly on a full length on middle and leg stump. Pandya gets forward and taps it towards short extra cover
full delivery fired through just outside off stump. Hardik comes half forward and dabs it towards backward point
length delivery on off stump that just sticks in the surface a touch. Hardik presses half forward and pokes it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gill hangs back in his crease and hacks it towards long on
length delivery on middle and off stump. Gill gets down on one knee and helps it past backward square leg for four!
full delivery outside off stump. Gill advances, yorks himself and digs it out towards extra cover
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump. Hardik presses forward and drives it crisply towards mid off, where the fielder misfields and ends up conceding four!
safe! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Hardik has a swipe at it and miscues it badly. Miscues it so badly that it lands well in front of the keeper
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. Gill bunts it down the ground and calls his captain through for the single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gill laces his short-arm jab but can't beat the fielder at mid wicket
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Hardik gets up on his toes and dabs it down to deep backward point to get off the mark

and he snaps up Saha! Full delivery outside off stump. Saha looks to go downtown but makes a mess of his stroke. He is too early into the shot and gets it right off the toe-end of the bat. Harshit settles himself at mid wicket and completes the catch without much fuss!
length delivery on middle and off stump. Saha has a stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball then rolls away towards short fine leg
tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Gill reaches out for it and pokes it towards mid off for one
back of a length delivery angled into leg stump. Saha has a swipe at it and misses as the ball pings off the back thigh into the off side
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gill helps it behind square on the leg side and saunters across to the other end
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Saha gets onto the back foot and swings it away towards deep backward square leg
four more! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Saha gets inside the line of the ball and tickles it fine past the keeper
short, wide and punished again! Too much width and Gill has all the time in the world to sit back in his crease and crack it past cover point
full delivery fired down the leg side. Gill does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
four more! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. The width allows Gill to throw his hands at it and thrash it past cover point

huge appeal, not given! Length delivery angled into middle and leg stump. On pitching, the ball decks away a shade and opens up Gill completely. It seems to flick the pad before racing away past short fine leg and KKR, on that assessment, go upstairs! If there is no bat involved, this could be very close. There is a spike when the ball is next to the bat, though and Gill survives!
shot! Length delivery outside off stump. Gill stands up tall on the front foot and crunches it past extra cover for four!
short delivery outside off stump. Saha takes a step down the track and cuts it towards cover point for one more run
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gill jabs it into the off side and gets across to the other end
dug into the track just outside off stump. Saha is too early into his swing and misses it completely
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gill tucks it towards mid wicket and canters across to the other end
wow! Full delivery angled into the stumps. Gill dances down the track and bludgeons it over the bowler's head for four! Russell had to duck for cover there!
length delivery on middle and off stump that nips away slightly. Gill closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge down to short third man
shot! Short and wide outside off stump. Gill gets on top of the bounce, gets his hands through the ball and slaps it past extra cover for four!
full delivery angled into leg stump. Saha comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gill gets onto the back foot and taps it towards mid off
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gill stands up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gill lets the ball come to him before playing it into the on side towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Saha hops up onto his toes and drops it into the off side for one more run
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gill gets onto the back foot and punches it towards deep backward point to get off the mark
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Saha gets up on his toes and runs it down to deep backward point for a single
